name: Awesome Coming Soon & Maintenance Mode
author: iamaliiraja

sections.description:
Awesome Coming Soon & Maintenance Mode is a complete WordPress plugin for launch pages, under construction pages, and maintenance screens.

Use it to:
* Show a Coming Soon page while building your website
* Enable Maintenance Mode during updates
* Capture leads before launch with a newsletter form
* Control who can bypass the maintenance page
* Set SEO title, meta description, and robots options

Whether you run a startup, agency, WooCommerce store, SaaS product, or client site, this plugin helps you keep a polished presence online while work is in progress.

Live Template Demos

Free templates
* Aurora
* Loft
* Blush
* Glassline

Pro template previews (visible in Free, selectable in Pro)
* Bloom
* Cipher
* Nexus
* Nova
* Ember

Free Features

  • One-click Coming Soon and Maintenance Mode toggle
  • Operating modes: Coming Soon, Maintenance, Redirect
  • 4 modern free templates
  • Live template preview in admin
  • Content controls: heading, subheading, message
  • Countdown timer with launch date and action behavior
  • Newsletter form with custom labels and GDPR consent
  • Social links and contact details
  • Logo, favicon, footer content, and branding settings
  • Background options: solid color, gradient, image
  • Color and typography controls
  • Access rules: logged-in and role-based bypass
  • SEO settings: title, description, keywords, robots/noindex
  • Responsive templates for desktop, tablet, and mobile

Upgrade to Pro

  • Premium templates
  • Video background support
  • Saved color palettes
  • One-click style presets
  • Extended design flexibility and future premium integrations

Why this plugin ranks well for launch workflows

  • Built specifically for coming soon page WordPress use cases
  • Includes full maintenance mode WordPress controls
  • Designed for under construction and pre-launch lead generation
  • SEO-ready launch pages with custom metadata controls
sections.installation:
1. Upload the awesome-coming-soon folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Open ACS Settings in wp-admin.
  4. Choose a template and customize content/design.
  5. Enable Coming Soon or Maintenance Mode.
sections.faq:
Is this a Coming Soon plugin or a Maintenance Mode plugin?

Both. You can run a Coming Soon page, Maintenance Mode page, or Under Construction page.

Can admins still access the real site?

Yes. Use Access settings to allow logged-in users or selected roles to bypass the page.

Can I collect emails before launch?

Yes. Enable the newsletter section and customize text/consent.

Does it work with WooCommerce and page builders?

Yes. It works independently of your active theme and page builder output.

Are Pro templates visible in Free?

Yes. You can preview Pro templates in Free, but selecting them requires Pro.
